resources.string: Print emergency sheet / save as PDF
Delete the codes for “%1$s”? Make sure you can still sign in to this account, for example with another 2FA method.
No accounts yet. Use + to add the 2FA code of a service.
Point the camera at the website's QR code. The export QR code of Google Authenticator works too – then all accounts are taken over at once.
Paste an otpauth://totp/… link, e.g. from a QR code reader or an export.
If you pick a login by hand, GhulSuite remembers this app and its signature for it. A fake app with the same name does not get it.
That is already there – nothing was added.
The fingerprints on this device have changed. For your security, please unlock with password and key and switch fingerprint unlock on again.
The vault files are damaged or were modified (%1$s).
This vault is protected with a different password or keys/key files than your suite. Open it as a separate suite.
This key does not support hmac-secret and cannot be used.
This export file is encrypted. Export without encryption in the other app and try again.
This file format is not recognised.
This recovery code is not valid – please check for typos.
This security key is not registered for this vault.
A security key is needed for this.
A key file is needed for this.
The last key or key file cannot be removed. Add another one first.
No security key found. Plug it in.
Not confirmed on the key (not touched or cancelled).
The connected USB device is not a FIDO security key.
USB access to the key was not allowed.
Too many wrong PINs in a row. Unplug the key and plug it in again.
The PIN of the key is blocked. Use your backup key or recovery code.
No PIN is set on the key.
The PIN does not meet the requirements of the key.
Quick unlock has expired. Please unlock with password and key once.
Quick unlock is not available. Unlock with password and key.
Timeout – the key was not touched in time.
This recovery code does not belong to this suite.
This key file does not belong to this suite.
For backups prefer “Export” in a vault's menu: the file then stays encrypted.
Format: CSV (title, user name, password, URL, notes) – readable e.g. by Bitwarden, KeePassXC and Proton Pass.
Format: one otpauth line per account – readable by most authenticator apps.
The file contains all passwords or 2FA secrets in plain text. Anyone who gets it can read them. Use it only to move to another app and delete it afterwards.
Open the vault once with its previous password and its key or key file.
Afterwards it is switched to your password, your keys and your recovery code. Its previous password no longer works for this file.

Your folder contains vault files with another password, e.g. from another suite or from before a password change. Open them once with their password – then they are switched to your protection and belong to your suite.
%1$s items cannot be imported (e.g. HOTP or unknown types).
Delete the export file afterwards – it is not encrypted.
Imported: %1$s entries, %2$s 2FA accounts. %3$s were already there.

Supported: Proton Pass (ZIP, JSON, CSV), Bitwarden (JSON, CSV), KeePass/KeePassXC and other CSV files, Proton Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS, otpauth links. Google Authenticator: scan the export QR code in GhulAuth.
Also add 2FA codes from logins to GhulAuth
Create a matching vault in the options first.
Bring over passwords and 2FA accounts from another app. Export there without encryption first, then choose the file.
Save the key file somewhere only you have access to, e.g. a USB stick, and keep a copy. Anyone with password and key file gets in – so do not keep it together with the password.
Name of the key (e.g. “Key on keyring”)
The vault already carries a recovery code – your existing emergency sheet stays valid.
%1$s copied – will be cleared from the clipboard shortly
Unencrypted file saved. Remember to delete it after the move.
%1$s accounts taken over from Google Authenticator, %2$s were already there.
No new vaults in the folder.
Warning: %1$s is older than last seen. Details in the options.
Unlocked. Your new password applies now. Create a new recovery code in the options.
The file is copied to your storage location. If it already carries a recovery code, its emergency sheet stays valid; otherwise you get a new code.
The entry will be deleted permanently.
No entries yet. Use + to add your first password.
Camera access is needed to scan QR codes. The image is processed only on this device.
Plug in the key. You touch it twice. Afterwards it opens the suite just like your other keys and key files – they stay unchanged.
Choose an app PIN with 6 to 12 digits. It only works on this device and only for quick unlock. After 5 wrong attempts it is deleted.
While GhulSuite is locked, only “Unlock GhulSuite” appears. The other app only gets the password after you pick it. Websites are recognised by their domain, so look-alike sites get nothing.
GhulSuite is not set as autofill service.
GhulSuite is the active autofill service.
GhulSuite fills logins in other apps and in the browser and offers to save new logins.
Recommendation: add a backup (second key or key file). If your only one gets lost, only the recovery code gets you back in.
Applies to the suite and all vaults. Keys, key files and the recovery code stay valid.
This code is shown only now. Write it down or print it and keep it in a safe place. The old code no longer works.
For moving from Proton, Bitwarden, KeePass, Aegis, 2FAS or Google Authenticator.
What opens your suite: the password plus one of the keys or key files. The recovery code opens everything on its own – keep it safe.
Language: follows the system. Since Android 13 you can choose it per app in the system settings (Apps › GhulSuite › Language).
Lock when the screen turns off
Switched-off modules disappear from the menu. Their data stays encrypted and unchanged.
A new recovery code is created. The previous code stops working.
Your suite is protected with a key file. A security key is even more secure: it cannot be copied.
The lock button and the notification lock normally. Shaking and the quick settings tile “Lock GhulSuite” are a panic lock: they additionally delete fingerprint and app PIN unlock.
Password and key are always required after a restart, after the validity ends, after a panic lock, after 5 wrong app PINs and when fingerprints are changed.
No secure fingerprint sensor or no fingerprint set up on this device.
After unlocking with password and key, you can open GhulSuite with your fingerprint or an app PIN for a while.
“%1$s” will no longer open your suite. Everything else stays valid.
Screenshots and screen recordings may then contain your passwords and codes, and the app is visible in the app switcher. Only allow this if you really need it.
GhulPass: show user names in the list
Every key and key file opens the suite together with your password. Adding or removing one does not affect the others.
GhulAuth: show next code shortly before expiry
All vault files in your folder belong to your suite. Each can also be taken along and opened on its own – with your password and key or with the recovery code.
Measuring the speed of this device…
I have written down or printed the code
This code opens all your vaults on its own – even if password, key and key file are gone. It is part of every one of your files. Write it down or print it and keep it safe, not on this device.
To be sure you have the code, enter its third group (5 characters).
That is not the third group.
Your key has no PIN yet. GhulSuite requires one – choose it now.
Plug in your FIDO2 security key via USB. You will be asked to touch it twice: once to register it and once to derive the key.
Your suite is always protected by two things: your master password and a second factor. Choose the second factor:
Choose a long password you can remember. Nobody can reset it – if you forget it, your data is lost.
This password is too easy to guess. Use a longer one or several words.
You also always get a recovery code to print. It opens everything, even if password, key and key file are gone.
Later you can add more keys or key files and remove old ones at any time – nothing becomes invalid, not even your recovery code.
A FIDO2 key via USB. It cannot be copied – a stolen password alone is useless.
A small file you keep e.g. on a USB stick. Good to start with; later you can swap it for a key.
You can create more vaults (e.g. “Work”) later in the options.
Which areas do you want to use? A vault is created for each. Areas you do not choose are hidden.
GhulSuite keeps your passwords and 2FA codes encrypted – on this device or in a folder of your choice. How do you want to start?
This recovery code opens your GhulSuite completely – even without master password, security key and key file. Keep this sheet as safe as cash, away from your devices and key.
Print it directly via USB or Wi-Fi Direct if possible. Network and cloud printers may keep print jobs. A saved PDF should not stay on this device.
Open GhulSuite and choose “Locked out? Use recovery code”.
Enter this code (dashes and upper/lower case do not matter) and set a new master password.
In the settings, remove lost keys and register new ones if needed.
Create a new recovery code and destroy this sheet.
Anyone with this sheet and your vault files can access all your data. Do not photograph it, do not store it in the cloud.
This is the settings file of a suite. Choose “Open existing suite” and then the folder it is in.
New suite with master password and security key or key file.
There are no GhulSuite files in this folder.
Choose the folder with your GhulSuite files, e.g. on a USB stick or in a synced folder.
A .ghlpss or .ghltotp file. It is copied to your storage location; only this area is switched on.
App storage is recommended. A folder of your own (e.g. a USB stick) is useful if you want to carry or back up the files yourself.
There already are GhulSuite files here.
The code opens everything. Then set a new master password. Keys, key files and the code stay valid.
Enter the recovery code from your emergency sheet.
You fully unlocked GhulSuite recently. Confirm it is you.
Plug in your security key, enter your master password and the PIN of the key.
Enter your master password and choose your key file.
Use password and key or key file
A .ghlpss or .ghltotp file. If it has another password, you are asked for it once and it is switched to your protection.
The new vault gets your password, keys and recovery code and is stored as a separate file in your folder.
There is no vault for this area yet.
Older than the last state seen – maybe an old copy.
The file is deleted from your folder. All its entries are gone unless you have a copy. Tip: export it first.
The server key is not confirmed yet (%1$s).
Warning: the server presents a different key (%1$s). Someone may be intercepting the connection. Nothing was transferred.
The server certificate is not trusted (%1$s).
The server rejected the login. Check user name, password or key.
The master password was changed on another device.
Your own server with SSH/SFTP access (e.g. a home server, NAS or rented server). GhulSuite only stores encrypted files there.
Relative to your home folder, e.g. "ghulsuite". It is created if needed.
Add this public key on the server to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys (one line). The private key stays encrypted in your suite.
First connection to this server. Compare the fingerprint with the server (ssh-keygen -lf /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub). Only continue if it matches.
The files on the server stay. Synchronisation and GhulDrive stop using this server.
For the synchronisation between your devices. GhulDrive’s storage is set in GhulDrive. Everything is encrypted before it leaves the device.
Keeps the vaults of this suite equal on all your devices. Changes on both sides are merged; nothing is overwritten silently.
The master password was changed on another device. Enter the new password to take it over on this device as well.
Your suite is already synchronised to your own server: download it to this device.
The encrypted suite is downloaded from the server. Afterwards you unlock it as usual with password and security key or key file.
Key of this device (only for downloading):
No suite found in this folder on the server.
Your files, encrypted on your own server. The server sees neither names nor contents nor folder structure.
Files are encrypted on this device before upload.
The file is deleted from the server.
The folder and everything in it is deleted from the server.
Use your existing e-mail address (IMAP/SMTP). The login is stored encrypted in your suite.
Server settings are suggested from the address; you can change them below.
Some providers (e.g. Gmail, iCloud, Outlook) require an app password for IMAP.
The incoming server uses a certificate that is not publicly trusted (e.g. self-signed). Only continue if the fingerprint matches your server.
The outgoing server uses a certificate that is not publicly trusted (e.g. self-signed). Only continue if the fingerprint matches your server.
Shown as text; images and links from the internet are not loaded.
Only open attachments from senders you trust.

Notifications also work while GhulSuite is locked. For this, a copy of the inbox login is kept on this device, protected by the Android Keystore. The server reports new e-mail at once; for this Android shows a silent ongoing notification “GhulMail is ready”. By default notifications only show the account name and the number of new messages (changeable below). The panic lock removes the copy. If e-mail still arrives late: turn off battery optimization for GhulSuite (offered when switching on).
The account is removed from GhulSuite. Your e-mails stay on the mail server.
The password is used once to add GhulSuite's key to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on the server. It is not stored; afterwards GhulSuite logs in with its key.
The password is stored encrypted in your suite and used for every connection.
On the server: %1$s (only encrypted blocks and an encrypted index)
Links you created – see downloads, withdraw
Files are encrypted on this device (AES-256-GCM, 1 MiB blocks). The server only sees encrypted blocks.
Encrypted on this device. The key is only in the link – the server cannot read the entry.
Module %1$s created with its own access key.
Already installed? Enter its address and access key below.
Module saved – upload it to your web space.
A single PHP file (PHP 8.1, no database) on any web space. Stores Drive data and share links; links can expire and be limited to a number of downloads.
The web folder, e.g. public_html or html/cloud.
Uploads the module through a server you already added (e.g. FTPS of the same web space).
Compare this certificate fingerprint with the one of your hoster before trusting it.
Encrypted FTP (explicit TLS). Plain FTP is not supported.
Access data as for your FTP program. The password is stored encrypted in the suite.
One file on your web space – best for share links
Decrypted on this device and handed over
End-to-end encrypted: the key is in the part of the link after #, which browsers never send to the server.
Set up a share folder first
Encrypted link with expiry and password
Opens GhulMail with the files attached

Hello,

here is %1$s for you:
%2$s

The file is end-to-end encrypted and opens in the browser.
Limiting downloads needs the PHP server module.
At least 4 characters. Tell the password in another way, e.g. by phone.
Protected with a password – send it separately.
Everything works. You can now share from GhulDrive and GhulPass.
Choose a folder that is published by your web server, e.g. inside public_html. Only encrypted packages are stored there.
Under which address can the folder %1$s be reached in the browser?
Link withdrawn – it no longer works.
The link stops working immediately. The file stays in GhulDrive.
Expired links are deleted from the server automatically.
Too large for a mail – please share as a link
Sharing: ready – with expiry, password and download counter
Windows asks for the PIN of your security key and for the touch in its own window.
Quick lock: the lock symbol at the top right, or Ctrl+L.
Show the QR code on the screen (e.g. in the browser), then scan. Or copy a picture of it.
Decrypted into a temporary folder; deleted when locking
Not end-to-end protected – like a postcard.
End-to-end encrypted – only you could read it.
Signed, but the sender's key is not known yet.
Warning: the signature does not match – changed on the way or forged.
Will be sent signed, but not encrypted.
No key yet for: %1$s. As soon as they write to you once (from GhulSuite, Thunderbird, Proton …), mail is encrypted automatically.
Added below every mail. Your mails are also signed digitally and automatically.
Only encrypted connections: IMAP with SSL/TLS; for sending SSL/TLS or STARTTLS (strict – never without encryption).
Works automatically: every mail is signed and carries your key; mail is encrypted as soon as the recipient's key is known. Keys are learned from mails, found at the recipient's provider, or imported.
None yet – they are learned automatically.
Mail to this address is no longer encrypted until a new key arrives.
Tap copies the code. Long press: rename, delete.
Separate several recipients with commas. Encrypted automatically as soon as all recipients have a key.
Insert your security key and touch it …
Passwords, 2FA, files and mail – encrypted on your devices and your own server.
No account, no cloud lock-in. A recovery code and an emergency sheet always come with it.
The part after “#” is the key. Browsers never send it to the server – it only holds encrypted content.
Applies to this device. The lock screen always shows only “New e-mail”. For encrypted mails the subject stays hidden because the suite is locked.
Scan with another device’s camera to join the Wi-Fi without typing. Nothing goes over the network.
The last 10 passwords stay encrypted in the entry – handy if a change on the website did not work.
Attachments (up to 10 MB each) are stored encrypted in the vault and synced with it.
Some tidying up is worth it
Everything is checked on this device only.
No one-time code in the entry or in GhulAuth
None of your passwords appears in known data breaches.
Via “Have I Been Pwned” with k-anonymity: only 5 characters of a hash leave the device.
Random words plus a number – easy to type, hard to guess (EFF word list).
Favourites always come first. Favourite: long-press an account.
Whoever sees this code can create your one-time codes. Only scan it to move to another app.
Device clock is accurate – codes are correct.
Device clock is off by %1$s s – codes may be wrong. Please let the time be set automatically.
No QR code found in the image.
Deleted items stay here for %1$s days and can be restored (Options → GhulDrive).
These files are also kept encrypted on this device and open without network.
When you upload a file with the same name again, the last 5 versions are kept.
AES-256 with a password – for e-mail or a USB stick
Opens with 7-Zip, WinZip or macOS (Keka). Share the password separately (at least 8 characters).
Everything in the trash is deleted for good. This cannot be undone.
After unlocking, new photos are backed up encrypted into the folder “Fotos”.
Swipe: right toggles read, left does the action from Options (archive, delete or read).
Encrypted mail is saved as it is on the server (encrypted).
It is sent as soon as GhulSuite is unlocked on one of your devices at (or after) that time.
Keep opened mail and lists encrypted on this device
One file with everything: vaults, settings, mail accounts, Drive directory. Everything stays encrypted – opening it needs password + key or the recovery code.
Restore: choose “Restore backup” on the start screen (into an empty location).
Show or hide areas in the bar
With device and version, no vault contents
Contains only version, device type and the last crash report – no passwords or content. Copy or save it and send it along.

Photo as PDF, encrypted right away
The photo could not be read.
Pick something on the left – it opens here.
Self-hosted passwords, 2FA, files and mail – open source under AGPL-3.0.
“GhulSuite” and the logo are marks of Daniel Erdmann. Changed versions need a name of their own.
The file contains the password in plain text. Delete it once you no longer need it.
On Windows the new language applies after restarting the app.
%1$s image(s) from the internet blocked – they could tell the sender that you read the mail.
Plug in your security key now
Waiting up to one minute – then touch it when it blinks.
No events – the day is yours.
No events in the next 60 days.
Searches one year back and ahead – only on the device, in the unlocked calendar.
Notification – also while the app is locked
Invitations go out as an .ics attachment by mail – no calendar server, no attendee tracking.
Events use local time: 10:00 stays 10:00, also when travelling.
Changes apply to the whole series
To remove single occurrences, delete them in their own view.
Saved only encrypted in the calendar vault (.ghlcal). Reminders are scheduled by the device itself – no server, no permanent notification.
Links stay inside the suite: the event only remembers what it points to.
Just type – day, time, repetition and #calendar are recognised.
Dentist Fri 10am|Run tomorrow 6:30pm-7:30pm #sports|Team call every Monday 9am #work|Grandma’s birthday 24.12. #family
%1$s events in the next year · encrypted
“%1$s” and all its events will be deleted – also on your other devices.
Every calendar is stored encrypted in your suite (.ghlcal) and syncs like your passwords via your own storage. Deliberately without CalDAV.
Built in and offline – nothing is looked up online.
“Event in 15 minutes” – without title and place

When unlocking, the device schedules the reminders of the next 30 days itself (Android: exact alarms, Windows: while GhulSuite runs). They arrive on time even while the app is locked – no server, no permanent notification.
Colours, visibility, import and export of .ics files from Google, Outlook, Apple or Thunderbird.
GhulCal speaks no CalDAV and subscribes to no foreign calendars. Events leave the device only encrypted – to your own storage. Exchange with other programs via .ics files or as a mail attachment.
As an .ics file – readable by any calendar program.
This file was made by a newer GhulSuite. Please update the app.
For web hosting without SSH: GhulSuite uploads its module once via FTPS and then works over HTTPS.
The app lists the folders on the server
ghulsuite.php and its data folder are in %1$s/
Derived from domain and folder. Only change it if your website has a different address.
The module does not answer at the usual addresses. Enter your website\'s address and check it.
For updates of the module. Off: GhulSuite only works over HTTPS with the module\'s key.
Your web hosting accepts at most %1$s per request. GhulSuite uploads larger files in smaller parts.
On the server · only encrypted files will be stored here.
On your web hosting · the folder must be reachable from the internet.
Delivered on the internet – not for vaults
Enter server, user and password first.
The password never leaves your device. Without password and second factor only the recovery code helps (step 8).
Recommended · YubiKey, Nitrokey … via USB or NFC
Plug in the key or hold it to the phone (NFC) and touch it when GhulSuite asks – after choosing the storage location.
Keep it on a USB stick or another safe place – not next to the suite.
To unlock you always need the password and this second factor. More keys or a spare key file can be added later in Options.
Recommended · only GhulSuite can reach it
USB stick, SD card, cloud folder – every file is encrypted on its own
The folder is the suite: all area files sit next to each other there.
Next, GhulSuite creates the suite. Touch your key twice when asked.
Only on this device for now
All devices sync through it – encrypted only
Optional. On other devices you then choose “Fetch from my server”. GhulDrive can use the same server or a completely different one – also with another method (next step).
Where should the files be stored?
GhulDrive then shows “Not set up yet”
You set up your mail account in GhulMail right after the setup.
Every chosen area gets its own file with its settings. Areas not chosen create no file and are hidden – switch them on any time in Options → Areas.
When GhulSuite is in the background or you do nothing.
Shake = panic lock: locks at once and deletes the quick unlock (fingerprint, PIN).
Everything can be changed later in Options → Locking and panic. Applies to this device only.
Quick unlock means: with your fingerprint or an app PIN instead of password and key – for the time between two full unlocks.
The app PIN needs 6 to 12 digits.
No expiry – but after a restart of the device, a panic lock or a password change you need password and key again.
The sync server · own folder drive/
SFTP, FTPS (web hosting) or GhulSuite PHP module
Use your existing mail address. The login is stored encrypted in the mail file of your suite.
Top: stored in the %1$s file, applies on all devices. Below: only on this device.
Display only – the file stays, other devices keep showing the area
Deletes the %1$s file on all devices
The %1$s file is deleted on all devices – with its content and settings.
Tip: export first what you want to keep. If you only do not want to see the area here, choose “Hide on this device”.
Every area is an encrypted file of its own with its settings. “Hide” applies to this device only, “Remove” deletes the file everywhere.
%1$s. The file %2$s is created – it is synchronised like everything else.
GhulMail then asks for your account.
Accounts and favourites live in the vault – there is nothing else to set here.
Your recovery code was never confirmed.
The setup was not finished, or a new code was not confirmed. GhulSuite now makes a new code: write it down and confirm it by typing one group back.
The sync server · only a reference, no copy of the login
The login is stored in the .ghldrv file
A new storage starts empty; existing files stay on the previous server. If the sync server is removed, GhulSuite asks what should happen with GhulDrive.
GhulDrive used the sync server, but synchronisation is off on this device. Choose where the files are.
Tip: if you set up a server in Options → Synchronisation, GhulDrive can use it too.
GhulDrive stores its files on the sync server. What should happen with GhulDrive?
No FTPS? Upload the module file yourself
The setup was interrupted. Unlock with your password and second factor – GhulSuite then completes the suite.
Counter-based code (HOTP) – GhulAuth only shows time-based codes
Item type “%1$s” has no counterpart in GhulSuite
Item type has no counterpart in GhulSuite
stays in its login, only not in GhulAuth
With the original data, in the folder “%1$s” – nothing gets lost. You can take it over by hand later.
Choose a GhulPass vault to keep them as notes.
%1$s not converted items kept as notes in GhulPass.
The %1$s selected entries will be deleted for good.
The %1$s selected 2FA accounts will be deleted. Make sure you can still sign in to these services.
Swipe right to edit, left to delete. Long press selects several.
Tap a login field. Suggestions appear below the field or in the keyboard\'s suggestion bar.
In an app GhulSuite first offers “Choose another login …”. After that it remembers the app and suggests the login directly.
Chrome: Settings → Autofill services → “Autofill using another service”, then restart Chrome. Firefox and browsers such as Vivaldi, Brave or Edge need no setting.
Nothing shows up? Long-press the field and choose “Autofill”.
